title: Ka'ena-style P-wave density, gravity, and elastic flexure inversion
summary: Convert a 2-D P-wave profile to density, forward-model a line-integral gravity anomaly, and invert periodic plate flexure for elastic thickness on hidden changed geometries.
taskPrompt: Read input/spec.md and input/problem.json. Implement output/solve.py with the exact density, gravity, Fourier plate-flexure, grid-search, trace, and invariant contract. The evaluator runs the same solver on two hidden profiles; network access and reference/ access are forbidden.
agentMustDo: Write reusable output/solve.py accepting --input PATH --output DIR
Emit result.npz, trace.csv, and summary.json with exact keys, units, shapes, and finite values
Use the supplied velocity/depth geometry rather than copying visible outputs

inputFiles.name: problem.json
inputFiles.description: Synthetic benchmark-authored Ka'ena-style layered P-wave profile, gravity observations, and flexure observations.

inputFiles.name: spec.md
inputFiles.description: Exact physical formulas, units, grid-search convention, and output schemas.

referenceFiles.name: hidden_case.json
referenceFiles.description: Evaluator-only changed 20-cell profile, layer velocities, and elastic-thickness grid.

referenceFiles.name: hidden_geometry.json
referenceFiles.description: Evaluator-only changed 10-cell geometry and layer structure.

evaluation: Score is 0.85 for complete physical arrays (including positive density and Te) and an additional 0.15 only when those arrays, the exact intermediate Te trace, and the units/invariant summary all pass. The candidate must also pass both hidden recomputations; scores are averaged across visible and hidden cases. Missing or malformed output scores 0.
